concept: Getting involved in a real local environmental effort (cleanup, conservation, community garden)
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student considers participating in a realistic local environmental effort
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides whether and how to get involved
exercise.practice: Student identifies one real, local opportunity that fits their own interests and constraints

assessment.success_marker: student names a specific, realistic local opportunity, not a vague global aspiration
